sources.title: WizardLM 2 official release announcement
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The original April 15 release explicitly describes WizardLM-2 as LLM post-training and names the 8x22B model. Its training methods change instructions, data and optimization; no pruning, expert expansion, distillation into a resized model or modality additions are described. Existing release, modality and license evidence is preserved.

sources.title: Original Microsoft WizardLM-2-8x22B model card, archived April 15, 2024
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved the actual April 15 Microsoft model-card capture with curl on October 27, 2026 after the web reader failed. The card explicitly identifies WizardLM@Microsoft AI, Mixture of Experts, base mistral-community/Mixtral-8x22B-v0.1 and nominal 141B parameters. This is an exact named-base declaration, not a name-similarity inference. No structural modification is described. Prior embedded metadata observations remain historical; no new shard census was performed.

sources.title: WizardLM release-process correction, April 16, 2024
sources.evidence: Direct X page fetch failed, but the first-party X syndication endpoint https://cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id=1780101465950105775&lang=en&token=0 returned the statement and creation time 2024-04-16T05:10:36Z. The team apologizes for missing required toxicity testing and says testing is being completed. Its embedded quoted announcement names 8x22B, 70B and 7B on April 15.

sources.title: Original Microsoft model repository, current access check
sources.evidence: Current model-page request returns HTTP 401. This does not invalidate the archived original card or imply current Microsoft weight hosting.

sources.title: Community archive provenance record
sources.evidence: Mirror metadata states source https://huggingface.co/microsoft/WizardLM-2-8x22B and download date 2024-04-15 16:48:15. This is the uploader provenance claim, not independent authentication of the original weights. The mirror was created April 16 and presently contains 59 accessible BF16 weight shards.

sources.title: Community mirror checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Freshly fetched the pinned mirror config October 27, 2026. Its 56 layers, width 6144, intermediate 16384, vocabulary 32000, 48 query/8 KV heads, eight experts and two selected experts per token exactly match the freshly fetched official Mixtral-8x22B-v0.1 base config. Model type and untied embeddings also match. This corroborates preserved geometry; the explicit lineage comes from the original Microsoft card, not mirror authenticity.

sources.title: Community mirror tensor index and all shard-header inspection
sources.evidence: Index maps 1739 tensors across 59 shards. Fetched only HTTP 206 length/header ranges for every shard at this revision, totaling 225120 bytes. All 1739 BF16 keys/shapes exactly matched expected Mixtral learned modules; no buffers, scales or packed storage. Sum 140620634112 agrees with archived original HF metadata, but header equality does not establish weight-value authenticity.

sources.title: Transformers 4.36.2 Mixtral implementation
sources.evidence: Implementation version named by the mirror config defines bias-free QKV/output projections, three expert matrices, router, learned RMSNorms, embeddings and LM head. Rotary frequencies and cached sin/cos are nonpersistent buffers. Routing chooses config.num_experts_per_tok experts. Used only to classify/count mirror header tensors, not to prove original fine-tune topology.

sources.title: Cheaper, Better, Faster, Stronger: original Mixtral 8x22B announcement
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Mistral explicitly reports Mixtral 8x22B as 141B total and 39B active parameters. The current first-party weights table separately confirms these numbers for both base and instruct weights. Combined with the original Microsoft named-base declaration and post-training description, 39B supports a labeled nominal inference for WizardLM-2 8x22B; no finer mirror-derived count is substituted.

sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. The first-party table explicitly labels Parameters (B) and Active (B), giving 141 and 39 for both base and instruct weights. Confirms the nominal active convention used for the identified WizardLM base; not an exact tensor calculation.

sources.title: Official Mixtral 8x22B v0.1 base configuration
sources.evidence: Freshly fetched October 27, 2026. Defines MixtralForCausalLM with 56 layers, hidden size 6144, intermediate size 16384, 48 query heads, 8 KV heads, 32000 vocabulary entries, 8 experts and 2 experts per token. All parameter-bearing dimensions match the pinned WizardLM mirror configuration. No weight shards were downloaded.

name.note: Use the original exact model spelling; distinct from WizardLM-2 7B, announced 70B, and later WizardLM-beta experiments.

developer.note: Original Microsoft card explicitly identifies WizardLM@Microsoft AI. Keep Microsoft as developer; alpindale is the mirror publisher, and Mistral is the base-model developer.

family.note: Official WizardLM-2 member of the WizardLM series; use the catalog family key wizardlm, separate from its Mixtral backbone.

release_date.note: Official dated release and contemporaneous original model-card capture establish April 15. Mirror creation on April 16 is later. The original card distinguishes the 70B weights as forthcoming, so family announcement alone is not used as proof for all siblings.

open_weights.note: The original April 15 public ungated Microsoft repository exposed BF16 safetensors, and the exact-named community archive currently serves 59 weight shards. Microsoft hosting is now inaccessible. Open weights does not certify an independently authenticated byte-identical mirror or an operating hosted endpoint.

license.note: Explicit official license for WizardLM-2 8x22B, independently confirmed by its original card. Do not use the sibling 70B Llama 2 license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit confirms the original Microsoft card directly reports nominal 141B total and explicitly identifies Mixtral-8x22B-v0.1 as the base. Retain this developer precision; the prior mirror census is not promoted to an exact original-checkpoint count.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference: the original Microsoft card explicitly names Mixtral-8x22B-v0.1 as base, and the official release describes post-training without a structural change. Mistral reports 39B active for this base. Fresh official-base and pinned-mirror configurations match all parameter-bearing dimensions and 2-of-8 expert routing. No pruning, expansion or modality change is described. Use the developer nominal convention, not the prior 39.152031744B mirror calculation; an exact original tensor census is unnecessary for this labeled inference.

architecture.note: The archived original Microsoft card explicitly says Mixture of Experts and names Mixtral 8x22B as base; embedded original metadata identifies MixtralForCausalLM. Mirror details corroborate but are not the sole basis.

context_window.note: Baseline 65536 is corroborated by the community mirror configuration, but the accessible original card and later first-party report do not specify original context. No archived original raw/blob/resolve config was found in exact Internet Archive queries. Clear the assertion under the primary-source requirement; do not silently inherit the base model 64K.

modalities.note: The original model card documents text-generation and Vicuna-format textual user/assistant turns. No multimodal input or output interface is part of this released model.

reasoning.note: Original primary materials describe reasoning tasks and Vicuna-style chat but do not separately specify a dedicated extended-thinking mode. No negative capability claim is inferred from this omission.

tool_call.note: No native structured tool-call protocol or tool-specific training is documented in the inspected original primary materials. Agent-task claims and the base model interface do not establish this fine-tune feature; omission does not prove inability.

description.value: Microsoft WizardLM team's multilingual text model, post-trained for complex instructions and multi-turn conversation using a Mixtral-8x22B-based mixture of experts.
description.note: Keeps developer, instruction/chat purpose, multilingual text and original-card MoE/base linkage. Avoids unsupported rankings, exact context, native agent tools or mirror-authentication claims.

patch.notes: Microsoft reports nominal 141B total. Nominal 39B active is inferred from the explicitly identified Mixtral-8x22B-v0.1 base and preserved MoE geometry. Official release was April 15, 2024; the team acknowledged missed toxicity testing the next day. Original hosting is inaccessible; community weights remain available without independent byte-authenticity verification. Original context remains unverified (mirror config 65536). Dedicated reasoning and native tool-call features are not separately documented.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit confirms nominal 141B total and recovers nominal 39B active through the original Microsoft named-base declaration, post-training description and Mistral active-count disclosure. Fresh base/mirror configurations corroborate preserved dimensions and routing; no structural change is described. The active count is explicitly a lineage inference, not an exact tensor count. All unrelated field assessments are preserved.
